/*
 * GENERATED FILE - DO NOT EDIT.
 *
 * This is hermetic's browser script: the web components in static/packages/,
 * bundled from TypeScript (entry point: static/packages/app/src/main.ts) with Bun
 * @BUN_VERSION@:
 *
 *     make -C static build
 *     (in packages/app: bun build src/main.ts --target browser --minify
 *      --banner <this comment> --outfile ../../dist/app.js)
 *
 * It is committed to the repository on purpose: the Rust binary embeds this file
 * (src/site/assets.rs) and writes it to _hermetic/app.js in every generated site,
 * and committing it keeps `cargo build` working on machines without Bun.
 * `make -C static verify` (run by `make lint`) rebuilds it and fails if this copy
 * is out of date. To change the script, edit the packages and run
 * `make -C static build`.
 */
